meta.scope: Connect Contested Fort progression, durability-first scarcity, survival consumption, rewards, and recovery without authorizing implementation.
meta.approvalMeaning: The study structure and verified findings are approved for continued design. Open balance inputs remain explicitly deferred and are not implementation requirements.

weaponDurability.repairRule: Repair is per weapon. A full restore may require up to 3 discrete Repair_Kit_Basic uses when all three weapons require repair. Fractional kit pooling is not allowed.

badgesAndCrates.interpretation: The player must prioritize crates; one full clear does not fund every crate.

survivalRates.interpretation: The rates are mathematically verified, but actual fort consumption requires an approved clear-time and fort-drain rule.

sustainabilityIntent.fullClear: requires preparation and may require overworld farming

resourceLoop: Overworld activity supplies survival, maintenance, and repair resources.
Fort activity consumes condition, supplies, time, and recovery capacity.
Badges provide progression choices rather than guaranteeing every crate each run.
The player is expected to alternate between overworld preparation and fort pressure.
The loop must remain recoverable after failure; no permanent wipe is authorized by this study.
approvedDesignRules.deathCost: Death drops backpack contents according to the active Contested Fort rule. Equipped-weapon treatment remains governed by the authoritative fort configuration and is not redefined here.

notYetAuthoritative.clearTimes: The 12/15/18 minute floor estimates are provisional study assumptions and are not authoritative requirements.
notYetAuthoritative.fortSurvivalDrain: No special fort multiplier is approved by this study. The existing survival rules remain unchanged until separately approved.
notYetAuthoritative.repairKitSource: No reliable repair-kit source is established here. This remains a required economy input.
notYetAuthoritative.scrapAndOverworldYields: No yield values are established here.
notYetAuthoritative.badgeConversion: No badge-to-resource conversion is established here.
notYetAuthoritative.foodVariantBalance: Food_Stew versus Food_Dried remains open for later balancing.

acceptanceCriteriaForNextRevision: Define or study overworld food, water, scrap, maintenance, and repair-kit yields.
Define evidence-based expected clear times for each fort floor.
Convert survival and repair costs into a common time/resource basis before claiming profit or loss.
Recheck death cost after resource values are defined.
Do not convert this study into Unity assets, code, scenes, prefabs, or ScriptableObjects.

nextStudy.purpose: Supply the missing resource-yield inputs needed to validate the intended fort economy.
